programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of HK's Handover with an anthology of 4 stories about an autistic young man, a reconciliation, a Chinese opera star & a Nepali youth.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai is framed for murder. He takes hostages at the police station and demands talk with a former negotiator. As they engage in a tense battle of wits, their perspectives gradually shift.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates a fatal explosion involving two women who look alike. As he delves deeper, Wei unveils a web of deceit as details from the past and present come together in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Eddie Peng charms as possibly the most handsome Monkey King alongside Shawn Yue & Ni Ni in this fantasy-action-adventure film.

programme.title: Legend of the Fist:The Return of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: As Japan's grip on China tightens, Chen Zhen returns to Shanghai to infiltrate the notorious Club Casablanca, whose owner is a Japanese collaborator.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: During the 1937 Nanjing Massacre, civilians hiding in Ji Xiang Studio are forced to develop film for the Japanese army, uncovering its atrocities and risking their lives to expose the truth.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, Jelly steals the loot and flees, with his other cohorts hot on his heel. They stumble onto a remote village with strange villagers and mysterious eerie occurrences.

programme.title: Battle Of The Wolf
programme.desc: A former special forces sergeant must protect his wife and fellow passengers aboard a hijacked plane, using his courage and tactical expertise to take down the terrorists and ensure everyone's safety.

programme.title: MUMU
programme.desc: Mumu connects her deaf father to the outside world, but their peaceful life is disrupted when she must adapt and fit in to the hearing world, while her father is ensnared by a gang to commit crime.

programme.title: Call Me Agent
programme.desc: Miu Ling, who dreams of becoming a secret agent, accidentally rescues an injured spy. He agrees to make her his apprentice, turning her upside down as she goes on madcap adventures.

programme.title: The Wig
programme.desc: Meng Zhong is a successful lawyer. During an investigation into a court case, he meets a girl who triggers his memories of a rainy night, revealing a long-hidden secret from 20 years ago...

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: Article 20
programme.desc: Prosecutor Han Ming battles a case of intentional injury, risking all for justice. In a gripping finale, he transforms it into a fight for fairness, defending what is right.

programme.title: Pass And Goal
programme.desc: After losing everything, a businesswoman starts over in Sham Shui Po, forming a kids' football team to face an elite squad. She chooses to rewrite their first half with her second.

programme.title: Cold War
programme.desc: Winner of 9 awards at the 32nd Hong Kong Film Awards! When a police van is hijacked, Deputy Commissioner M.B Lee launches a rescue operation codenamed Cold War.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A fortune teller predicts that Tung will be imprisoned for murder, he tries to change his fate but a veteran detective believes Tung to be a psychopathic serial killer & pursues him relentlessly.

programme.title: My Country, My Parents
programme.desc: Set against four different eras, this 4-part anthology directed by Wu Jing, Zhang Zi Yi, Xu Zheng & Shen Teng depicts how China's forefathers fought to defend the nation & family honour.

programme.title: Someone Like Me
programme.desc: Ah Mei, bound by cerebral palsy and her mother's push for a forced hysterectomy, finds love with Ken through a disability intimacy service. Together, they forge a tender bond that defies all barriers.

programme.title: My Date With A Vampire
programme.desc: Demon slayer Ma Siu Ling crosses paths with a mysterious detective while probing bizarre cases. From distrust to fate-bound allies, they join forces against a dark threat looming over the city.

programme.title: Trouble Girl
programme.desc: Down with ADHD, Xiao Xiao faces school bullies and family issues. Her teacher Paul is her solace, but when she witnesses a secret between her mother and Paul, it adds complexity to her emotions.

programme.title: The Movie Emperor
programme.desc: A Hong Kong megastar decides to make a film about rural China to win an award at a film festival. He experiences village life for a farmer's role, but this results in a series of hilarious events.

programme.title: Cold War 2

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles

programme.title: NISEKOI Ep15

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep03

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep04

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep06
programme.desc: Learning about Nephy's abduction, Zagan hesitates to go to her rescue. Barbatos, the abductor, tries to harm Nephy after learning that Zagan is now an Archdemon, but Zagan suddenly appears.

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep01
programme.desc: Ryusei Narukami, former Dark Lord and NEET, reunites with Meteor Hanaori, the former hero. Due to their carelessness, they are mistaken for a couple, and a chaotic school life begins!

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep02
programme.desc: Meteor and Ryusei attempt to uncover the true identities of the new transfer students, Mana Kuraishi and Minto Takigawa, but get caught. At night, a mysterious monster appears in the park!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep03
programme.desc: An Eater appears during Meteor and Ryusei's Dungeon Date! What's more, a monster called a Tomath also appears at the school. Behind it all is a mysterious girl who wants the Dark Lord...!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep04
programme.desc: School beauty Ayame Takanashi makes a move on Ryusei! Apparently, she used to be a totally different person..? Amid the escalating chaos, Sakura calls an emergency couples therapy session!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep05
programme.desc: Ryusei's troubles are never-ending as a school teacher. While Meteor struggles with her sense of purpose, Ryusei offers encouragement. After school, their patrol somehow turns into a date!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep06
programme.desc: Meteor transforms into a cat thanks to Minto! She enjoys her new form, even laying on Ryusei's lap. Later, Eriko Asahina, a magical girl from another world, appears and attacks Ryusei!?

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep07
programme.desc: Meteor falls into darkness after obtaining the 'Ring of Darkness'! Calling herself the 'Avenger', Meteor challenges Ryusei to a duel. He unleashes the Dark Lord's full power against her.

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep08
programme.desc: Meteor launches a 'lap pillow' attack on Ryusei!? A rare item appears on a channel with a shocking price!? Many are intrigued by Ryusei when he visits Oz, though some have ulterior motives.

programme.title: Hanaori-san Still Wants to Fight in the Next Life Ep09
programme.desc: A robot from another world bumps into Ryusei and falls in love with him. Meanwhile, Ayame is hassled by some bullies, and things take a sinister turn!? Later, the Mitsurugi Festival begins!

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep03
programme.desc: Eiyu acts coldly to Shio to avoid getting ridiculed after they discover his secret collection of rom-com manga about childhood friends. Shio plans an ambush in the gym storage room but...

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep04
programme.desc: Runako, Eiyu's younger childhood friend who used to live nearby, is back. What's more, she declares, 'I love you, Eiyu-oniichan!' The arrival of a third childhood friend spells trouble.

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep05
programme.desc: Eiyu receives his final exam results and realizes he needs to lock in on his studies. He ignores the girls' invitations for a fun summer vacation, but they have a plan in mind: Swimsuits.

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep06
programme.desc: The group arrives at the beach! In the evening, Eiyu and Akari miss the last bus and have to walk back down the mountain. When they reach the inn, the two end up sharing a room...

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep07
programme.desc: Akari blurts out, 'I like you.' Confused, Eiyu confides in Runako. The summer fireworks festival approaches. Shio and Akari both think, 'I want to see this year's fireworks with Eiyu.'

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep08
programme.desc: It's the day of the Fireworks Festival. Eiyu goes to a quiet spot to calm down, only to run into Akari. Then, Shio calls to say she can't make it for the fireworks. What happened to Shio...?

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep09
programme.desc: Haru Hinata, a track team member and also a childhood friend, appears! Eiyu and the others assumed she was a boy in the past. The rom-com levels up one more with a new childhood friend!?

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep10
programme.desc: Shio is unsettled by Eiyu and Haru's kiss. She runs into Haru during a jog and asks, 'Do you like Eiyu?' but Haru dodges the question. Later, Shio unexpectedly kisses Eiyu?!

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep11
programme.desc: Akari is shocked to learn that Shio kissed Eiyu. Meanwhile, Haru also realizes her 'strange feelings' toward Eiyu. With each harboring complex emotions, the turbulent sports festival begins-

programme.title: You Can't Be in a Rom-com With Your Childhood Friends! Ep12
programme.desc: 'Isn't it weird that this is turning into a rom-com with childhood friends?' Eiyu says, leaving the girls bewildered. Is love a hindrance to their bond? The answer awaits at the relay race!

programme.title: Miracle in Cell No.7
programme.desc: A mentally challenged father who's wrongly jailed for the murder of a young girl reunites with his young daughter in the prison.

programme.title: Gyeong-ah's Daughter
programme.desc: After her husband passed away, Gyeong-ah relies on her daughter Yeon-su. But they barely meet each other. One day, Gyeong-ah gets an anonymous message about Yeon-su and goes into trauma...

programme.title: Concrete Utopia
programme.desc: Seoul has laid in ruin after an earthquake, leaving one single apartment remains standing. The apartment's resident representative strives to protect residents from outsiders...

programme.title: The Priests
programme.desc: After a girl is assaulted, two priests must determine if she was attacked by an evil spirit or a molester.

programme.title: The Exclusive: Beat the Devil's Tattoo
programme.desc: When a journalist discovers that his exclusive story on a serial killer was based on false information, he fabricates more lies to cover his mistake.

programme.title: Whispering Corridors 6
programme.desc: Returning to her alma mater as vice-principal, Eun-hee who's plagued by lost memories joins a bullied student to uncover the dark truth behind a haunted restroom and a long-buried tragedy.

programme.title: The Unfair
programme.desc: A protest against urban renewal leads to death of a cop and a teen. The boy's father was arrested for the cop's death. A young attorney is assigned to defend the father.

programme.title: Countdown (2023)
programme.desc: When an Olympic gold medalist boxer met a young boxer who falls victim to match fixing, he vows to start a boxing team at the school he teaches at and give his student a shot at the nationals.

programme.title: The Roundup: Punishment
programme.desc: Ma Seok-Do investigates a drug-trafficking app, uncovers a link to an illegal organization. As Baek Chang-Gi terrorizes the gambling market, an alliance is formed to stop the threat.

programme.title: The Ghost Game

programme.desc: Mengisahkan percintaan dan konflik antara Dira dan Rizal sehingga dia membawa dirinya ke Beijing. Takdir menemukan Dira dan cinta lamanya di Beijing secara tidak diduga.

programme.title: Mael Lambong
programme.desc: Mael Lambong merupakan seorang penarik kereta terkenal di KL. Kehidupannya mula menjadi huru-hara setelah berjumpa dengan Maria yang meminta bantuannya untuk mengelak dari penjahat yang mengejarnya.

programme.title: The Tuk Tuk of the Fifth Kind
programme.desc: A Tuk Tuk driver strongly believes that he is able to communicate with an alien from another star. The alien promises to bring him to their Utopia planet if he completes a mission.

programme.title: The Making of Chelot
programme.desc: Saksikan di sebalik tabir pembikinan filem Chelot.

programme.title: Surga Di Bawah Langit
programme.desc: Ayu, Agus dan Laras bergelut setiap hari demi kelangsungan hidup tanpa pernah mengimpikan apa-apa. Apabila dewasa, mereka bertemu semula di tempat yang mereka janjikan.

programme.title: TERBANG The Making Of
programme.desc: Haunted by tragedy, Ajeet returns to rally races with Kitt and Imran. Can Malaysia's underdog PERT team top the world's best? Inspired by the extraordinary journey of Malaysian rally legend Karamjit Singh.

programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy adalah anak kepada orang kaya yang ingin bebas dan bergaul dengan pemuzik di kelab malam. Anak Tengku Aziz bertunang dengan Tengku Johan.

programme.title: Suara Kekasih
programme.desc: Kisah percintaan terhalang dan terlarang di antara seorang artis dengan seorang pemuda dari keluarga berada. Lakonan Fauziah Ahmad Daud, Azmil Mustapha, Norlida Ahmad (Connie) dan Datin Rosnani Jamil.

programme.title: New York Cinta
programme.desc: Mia melanjutkan pelajaran ke Amerika Syarikat untuk mendalami bidang muzik namun ditakdirkan dia bertemu dengan Seth lalu jatuh cinta.

programme.title: Citra Exclusive: Tergantung Rindu
programme.desc: Kisah 2 beradik yang terpisah disebabkan hutang bapa saudara mereka berusaha untuk bertemu semula Mereka mengumpul duit dengan menjadi pemuzik jalanan.

programme.title: Oh Mak Kau
programme.desc: Sam dan Mun adalah dua perompak. Ketika wanita kegemaran mereka kembali ke kampung dari bandar, keduanya menghadapi pengalaman yang mengubah hidup di tengah persaingan untuk memikat hati sang wanita.

programme.title: 7 Minggu Sebelum Kahwin
programme.desc: Hanya tinggal 7 minggu saja tarikh perkahwinan, pelbagai masalah menimpa Amar dan Syifa yang mengganggu persiapan dan menduga cinta mereka.

programme.title: Baik Punya Cilok
programme.desc: Cerita subahat empat orang sahabat yang merompak orang jahat untuk tujuan menyempurnakan hajat arahan Afdlin Shauki lakonan bersama Awie, Hans Isaac, AC Mizal dan Riezman Khuzaimi.

programme.title: Langit Cinta
programme.desc: Alif Zulkarnain berasal daripada keluarga berada. Tetapi, dia mendapati wang bukanlah segalanya selepas bertemu dan jatuh cinta dengan seorang gadis kampung bernama Khadijah.
